title: Lymphoedema Research Brief
summary: A patient-and-carer summary of recent research, what the findings may mean, and where important uncertainty remains.
changes: Published the first source-reviewed evidence edition.
Separated published findings from trials that do not yet have results.
Added Australian care and urgent-infection resources.

trials.title: The LYMPH Trial — microsurgical versus conservative treatment of chronic breast-cancer-associated lymphoedema
trials.population: Adults with chronic breast-cancer-associated upper-limb lymphoedema
trials.design: Pragmatic randomised international multicentre comparison of microsurgery and conservative complex decongestive therapy
trials.caution: Recruitment and registration do not show that surgery is better. The primary completion date is still in the future and no results are reported here.

trials.title: Efficacy of GLP-1 receptor agonists in upper- and lower-extremity lymphoedema
trials.population: Adults with unilateral upper- or lower-extremity lymphoedema who meet the study criteria
trials.design: Early Phase 1, open-label, single-group interventional study
trials.caution: This is an early, uncontrolled study with no posted results. It does not establish GLP-1 medicines as a lymphoedema treatment and is not a recommendation to use them.

title: Lymphoedema Research Brief
summary: A patient-and-carer summary of recent research, what the findings may mean, and where important uncertainty remains.
changes: Corrected edition 2026.08.2 so children and adolescents are visibly presented as the main public-report focus, not only in the discovery report.
Placed the unchanged reviewed summaries under Other current evidence and ordered primary-lymphoedema biology before cancer-related exercise evidence.
Added a visible deferred-evidence section while keeping unreviewed candidates separate from published findings.

childrenFocus.summary: The latest 45-day discovery scan identified five publication candidates and three recently updated trial records involving children or adolescents. None has completed the source review required for inclusion in the patient-facing evidence summary.

deferredCandidates.title: Randomized Trial Assessing Prospective Surveillance and Exercise for Preventing Breast Cancer-Related Lymphedema in High-Risk Patients
deferredCandidates.reason: The trial is relevant but substantially overlaps the resistance-training prevention evidence already summarised.
deferredCandidates.revisitWhen: Reassess during the next exercise evidence update or if it materially changes the current interpretation.

deferredCandidates.title: LYMPHA Technique to Prevent Arm Lymphedema After Breast Cancer Treatment: A Single-Center Study Based on a 15-Year Follow-Up Period
deferredCandidates.reason: The long follow-up is potentially important, but the non-randomised single-centre design and selection across a long treatment era require detailed appraisal.
deferredCandidates.revisitWhen: Reassess after full source review of selection, comparator, follow-up, harms, funding and conflicts.

deferredCandidates.title: Non-pharmacological therapies for breast cancer-related lymphedema: a systematic review and network meta-analysis based on randomized controlled trials
deferredCandidates.reason: Treatment rankings should not be interpreted for patients until risk of bias, network connectivity, heterogeneity and certainty are assessed.
deferredCandidates.revisitWhen: Reassess after a human reviewer completes the network meta-analysis appraisal.
